verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v1: nuʿāta l-ḥilmi fī rūmā ṣabāḥā daʿūnā nabki dahrā ʾaldumūru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v2: hutāfu sh-shaʿbi waz-zuʿamāʾi fīhā hutāfu ḥawla dunyānā yadūru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v3: laqad ḥajazūhu ṭughyānā wajawrā wahal ʿarafūhu yaṭghā ʾaw yajūru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v4: kamā qatalūhu ḥurrā ʿabqariyyā ʾilā ghāyātihi l-fuḍlā yasīru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v5: limādhā ʾabʿadūhu ʿani l-qaḍāyā wahum qawmu limā faʿalūhu būru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v6: famūrū la yamūtu bimawti jismi wayamlaʾuhu bimaḍjaʿihi s-surūru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v7: walakin ʾantumu l-mawtā limā fī ṣudūrikumu waqad māta ṣ-ṣudūru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v8: ʾidhā māta l-fatā kalbā ʿaqūrā fayuḥkamu ʾannahu l-kalbu l-ʿaqūru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v9: jahiltum qīmata l-ʾinsāni ḥattā ghadā fīkum walaysa lakum maṣīru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v10: ẓalamtum khayrakum ẓulmā ʿaẓīmā fasāda ʿalaykumu fīhi l-ghurūru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v11: ʾabīsmi l-ḥaqqi yuẓlamu wahwa fīkum linahji l-ḥaqqi miṣbāḥu munīru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v12: ʾilaha muḥammadi waʾilaha ʿīsā faṣubba ʿalayhi maghfirata tujīru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v13: waʾarsil lil-junūdi l-ḥumri nārā tuqallibuhum ʿalayhā zamharīru
verses.nu-ata-l-hilmi-fi-ruma-sabahan-c1-v14: wakun fī sh-shaʿbi waz-zuʿamāʾi kula khalīfatahu waʾanta bihi jadīru
